minor.issue: Outbound webhook headers still carry the old brand: User-Agent 'AussieBack-Webhook/1.1', 'X-AussieBack-Event', 'X-AussieBack-Signature'. Not user-visible, but it is the public contract seen by the live flowtax.io consumer — renaming needs a coordinated change (or dual-send both header names) so it is a deliberate decision, not a sweep miss.
Internal logger name is still 'aussieback' and docstrings/examples reference aussieback.com. Cosmetic only (log prefix visible in supervisor logs).

No admin endpoint exists to delete a lead (only comments, blog posts, autopilot queue, outbox rows have DELETE). QA/GDPR erasure currently requires direct MongoDB access — my test suite now cleans up via motor for this reason.

ui_bugs.issue: The downloadable/preview share card still paints the legacy monogram letter 'A' (AussieBack) in the logo square next to the word 'refundmysuper' — see ShareCardModal.jsx:353 ctx.fillText("A", 128, 138). Brand-sweep miss on a user-shared asset.

issues: 'Approx. date you left Australia' uses the native browser date input rendering mm/dd/yyyy — US order for an Australian product, and inconsistent with the shadcn calendar used elsewhere. Suggest the shadcn Calendar/Popover with dd/mm/yyyy.

The 'Still there?' WhatsApp chat nudge auto-opens bottom-right and visually covers the WhatsApp-number field and part of the 'Reveal my refund' row on a 390x844 viewport. Programmatic click still succeeded (not blocking), but a real thumb tap can land on the nudge. Consider suppressing the nudge while the estimator form is in view.
